subject: Re: OpenRelay - request for community maintainer credits
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@openrelay.org>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenRelay Maintainers <maintainers@openrelay.org>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: credits for OpenRelay CI / community maintainer support

Hi Sofia,

Hope you9re well — I manage dev infrastructure for OpenRelay, an open-source project focused on low-latency messaging for civic apps. Our CI and test farms ran up unexpectedly high inference costs after a model update last month. A number of our maintainers are small nonprofits and individual contributors; predictable free credits from vendors like Redwood make it feasible for us to keep the project running.

Could Redwood provide a maintainer/community grant (30k token credits/month for 6 months) applied to the OpenRelay organization account? We9re also happy to provide a short sustainment plan and a blurb if you highlight community projects.

Quick details:
- GitHub repo: https://github.com/openrelay/openrelay
- Typical monthly token usage (pre-spike): ~8k tokens/month for test harness and preflight checks
- After update (Jan): ~28k tokens/month
- Benefit: keeps CI running so maintainers can test PRs from contributors worldwide

I attached a short sustainability plan and our Jan cost dump. Happy to provide more info or jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez\Infrastructure Lead, OpenRelay
lina@openrelay.org

Attachment: openrelay-sustainability-plan.pdf (1.2MB)
Attachment: ci-costs-jan2026.csv (10KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@openrelay.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenRelay CI / community maintainer support

Hi Lina,

Thanks for the detailed note and the attachments — very helpful. Quick clarifying questions so we can move this through the grants flow:

1) Is there a single Redwood account or org you want the credits applied to (email or org slug)?
2) Do you need the credits to be auto-refilled monthly, or a one-time lump issuance?
3) Would you be open to a short quote from a maintainer we can feature in a customer/community spotlight?

Marcus (Head of Developer Programs) and Karthik (Billing) are cc9d to help approve and do the issuance. If you can reply with the org slug and preferred delivery we9ll route for approval today.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova\Developer Programs, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenRelay CI / community maintainer support

Appreciate the context. Approve in principle: 30k tokens/month for 6 months (auto-refill) sounds reasonable for a critical OSS project with a clear CI impact. Marketing can run a small feature if they get a blurb.

Karthik, can you confirm this is covered under the community credits budget and share any constraints (promo vs org-bound credits)? If we can issue org-bound credits (non-transferable) that9s preferred.

If all good, Sofia to confirm with Lina and we9ll create the grant and promo asset.

- Marcus
Director, Developer Programs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenRelay CI / community maintainer support

On Fri, Feb 13, 2026 at 11:02 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Appreciate the context. Approve in principle: 30k tokens/month for 6 months (auto-refill) sounds reasonable for a critical OSS project with a clear CI impact.

Thanks — confirmed we have budget under the community grants line. Two operational notes:

- We prefer to issue org-bound credits (applied to account slug) rather than public promo codes for this.
- Need the following to complete issuance: canonical org slug, legal contact email (for audit records), and target start date.

Sofia: Lina can reply with those, and I9ll create the grant in Billing. Expect creation + first refill within 48 hours of receiving required metadata.

Karthik
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@openrelay.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OpenRelay - request for community maintainer credits

Hi Lina — thanks for the quick follow-up earlier. Per Karthik: we can issue org-bound credits. Please confirm the three items below and I9ll ask Billing to finalize:

1) Redwood org slug to apply credits to: openrelay-org
2) Legal contact email for records: grants@openrelay.org
3) Target start date: 2026-02-20

If that9s all correct we will:
- Issue 30k tokens/month, auto-refill for 6 months, non-transferable, applied to openrelay-org
- Generate a small one-paragraph spotlight we9d like to publish; you can opt out if desired
- Attach issuance receipts to your invoices and record in our audit logs

Once Karthik confirms he9s created the grant I9ll send a confirmation with the grant id and first-refill ETA.

Thanks again — excited to support OpenRelay.

Best,
Sofia
Developer Programs, Redwood Inference
